name: confirm_delete_note
description: Delete one note from the demo note list, after asking the user to confirm. The first call returns an input request (a yes/no form, MCP 2026-07-28 elicitation) instead of a result; the client shows it to the user and calls again with the answer. Confirming deletes the note and returns what is left; declining, cancelling or answering no returns a normal result saying nothing was deleted, never an error. The list is a fixed in-memory demo (groceries, ideas, todo) rebuilt on every call, so nothing is really lost; a name that is not on the list returns a normal result saying so, without asking. Needs a client that speaks MCP 2026-07-28 and supports elicitation; older clients get a tool error that says so.

note.description: name of the note to delete: groceries, ideas or todo

output.description: what was deleted and what remains, or that nothing was deleted
